data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'nafaza' meaning 'gift' or 'grace'. In Islamic tradition, the name Nafizah represents a gift or blessing bestowed by Allah. The name Nafizah carries the meaning “Gift from Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nafizah usually hope their child will grow to embody gift from allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
